name: Impetus of Zeus
description:
While gliding, you gather [yellow]static charge[/yellow], and temporarily slow down while aiming a ranged weapon or spyglass. At full charge, your next fired projectile [effect:lightning][yellow]becomes lightning[/yellow][/effect].

[dark-gray]"Strike them down, for they are beneath me."[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Lightning projectiles gain trueshot and strike lightning upon colliding. If it strikes an enemy, the lightning deals the same damage as the projectiles.
